company: First Light | Alkem Labs, Oil India, Eicher Motors
headline: First Light | Alkem Labs, Oil India, Eicher Motors

highlights: OIL INDIA ▪ Consolidated revenue rose 37.4% YoY, as standalone crude volumes grew 20%, realisation grew 35% and NRL’s revenue rose 24% ▪ Crude output is at a 4mmt run-rate, and NRL’s expansion to 9mmtpa is due by Mar-27; gas growth depends on pipeline connectivity ▪ Maintain BUY; TP raised to Rs604; we roll forward to Sep’28E and value the stock at 6.5x Sep’28E EPS Click here for the full report.
Healthy product sales led to 17.6% YoY growth in gross profit to Rs 30.5bn.
Due to 2.5 months inclusion of Occlutech’s business, employee cost grew 26.2% and SG&A (ex-R&D) grew 13.4%, leading to EBITDA growth of 11% YoY to Rs 10.2bn.
Higher integration costs led to 49bps YoY decline in EBITDA margin to 22.5%.
valuation: Valuation: Factoring in higher depreciation and finance cost due to integration, we cut our EPS by 2.5%, 4.1%, 2.7% for FY27E, FY28E and FY29E to Rs 176.7, Rs 202.4 and Rs 234.6, respectively.
At CMP, on Sep’28E EPS of Rs 219, the stock is trading at a P/E of 24x.
We continue to ascribe a P/E of 21x as ALKEM 1) reported industry-low margin (amid pharma margin of 26%) and 2) will focus on international markets going forward.
watch: Outlook on growth: Management guides for crude production of about 4.0mmt in FY27E, against about 3.5mmt in FY26, rising to 4.2–4.3mmt thereafter.
